component.name: OpenBlock
component.summary: Mine, build, explore and survive in an open voxel world

description.p: OpenBlock is an open-source voxel sandbox game. Mine, build, explore and survive alone or with friends on servers you host yourself.

It targets the Minecraft Java feature set as a baseline, then goes further with a scriptable content platform, GPU-driven rendering and a multiplayer stack designed for self-hosted servers. It contains no Minecraft code or assets and is not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.

Front-end (title screen, world browser/creation, multiplayer connect and recent servers), interactive key rebinding, accessibility options and multiplayer name tags, plus a measured 8-player server load gate and cross-platform fixes.

Multiplayer alpha with a self-hostable dedicated server and server-authoritative survival, mobs and combat, ores/furnace/smelting, iron tools and armor, chests, procedural audio, caves and ore veins, plus server operations tooling and benchmark coverage.
Readable spaced-out F3 overlay and menus, settings that can be lowered via clickable arrows (not only raised), and dropped items that are attracted and picked up within a 3 m radius.
Crafting and tools (planks, cobblestone, crafting table, sticks, wooden/stone tools with durability), visible dropped-item entities with automatic pickup, and a full tabbed Esc settings screen.
Survival foundations (health, hunger, fall damage, block drops, an item inventory, apples and eating, death/respawn, persisted state) plus crouch/sneak, sprint and improved movement.
Runtime loading of Minecraft-format resource packs for block textures with biome tinting, per-layer fallback, persisted selection and an in-game settings toggle.

Inventory and hotbar management, hold-to-mine with block hardness and a targeted-block outline, a day/night cycle with sun, moon and stars, and five biomes with blended terrain and biome-specific surfaces and trees.
Four selectable procedural texture styles (classic, painterly, lush, minimal) with mipmapped textures, cut-out leaves, distance fog, a sky gradient and subtle per-quad lighting variation.
HUD, F3 debug overlay, pause/settings menu with persisted options, in-game screenshots, parallel chunk meshing and generation, and data-driven content packs with save-format content binding.
Textured greedy-meshed rendering, frustum culling, compressed saves (729x smaller on the reference world) and a benchmark harness.

Tech preview: a runnable single-player vertical slice (procedural terrain, walk/fly physics, block break/place, save/load) plus a headless host. Multiplayer, UI text and audio arrive at later milestones.
